paragraphs.source_zh: “你听我说，”三成声音温和，语调却严厉，“这是三成的好意，三成唯一能够回报你们的好意。”

paragraphs.source_en: “No matter what you say, my lord, I could never hand you over. I will never do such a thing.”

paragraphs.source_en: “That is precisely why I said I would take you across in a small boat!”

units.source_en: “That is precisely why I said I would take you across in a small boat!”

paragraphs.source_en: “Go and claim the reward. Do not bring disaster upon the entire village. Mitsunari will gladly… send himself onward to the Pure Land.”

paragraphs.source_en: The man stood frozen in the darkness. He seemed to understand Mitsunari’s painful intention, and now wrestled alone with the choice: should he claim the reward, or cast the entire village into the abyss?

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly, Mitsunari felt light throughout his entire body. His destination had been Osaka, but now the road to Osaka was closed, and he was destined to be bound hand and foot—yet what of it? It was enough that, before he died, he could still gaze calmly upon the human world.

paragraphs.source_en: “To think that, at the very end, I should meet a man like you. Mitsunari’s life may now be called complete.”
